text.p: Tropical Cyclone Ophelia is becoming less of a threat to shipping. The system is still well northwest of Australia and it is moving towards the west-southwest. It is expected to weaken and dissipate over the open water northwest of Australia within the next 24-48 hours.

Tropical Depression 41W is a minor threat to shipping in the southern South China Sea. The depression has 30 mph winds and is centered near 5n/109e, moving west at 1 mph. It should remain over open waters and dissipate within 12-24 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
